.github/workflows/native-runtime-release.name: Build the three native executables, bootstrap, SBOM and provenance
.github/workflows/native-runtime-release.run:
cd "$NATIVE_WORKSPACE"
python3 tools/build_native_runtime.py --commit "$GITHUB_SHA" --version "$NATIVE_VERSION" --output "$PWD/target/native-release"
cargo +1.97.1 fmt --manifest-path tools/native-fixture/Cargo.toml -- --check
cargo +1.97.1 build --locked --release --manifest-path tools/native-fixture/Cargo.toml \
  --target x86_64-unknown-linux-gnu --target-dir target/native-fixture-build --jobs 2
install -D -m 0755 target/native-fixture-build/x86_64-unknown-linux-gnu/release/latent-native-vm-fixture target/native-test-tools/fixture-helper

.github/workflows/native-runtime-release.name: Use maintained validation profile and pinned dependencies

python3 -m unittest tools.tests.test_native_runtime tools.tests.test_native_release_gate
python3 tools/validate_workflow_actions.py
python3 tools/validate_docs.py
